synopsis: The third season of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken . Rimuru has officially become a Demon Lord after defeating Clayman. Meanwhile, in the Holy Empire of Lubelius, home base of the monster-hating cult of Luminism, Holy Knight Captain Hinata receives a message from Rimuru.
